english.title: Place / leave vehicle / bicycle / conveyance on the Transport for London regional railway network contrary to direction
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), while in charge of a

(A)_[motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[bicycle,]_
(C)_[a conveyance, namely **(..SPECIFY THE CONVEYANCE..),]_

left or placed it on a part of the Transport for London regional railway network, namely **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), otherwise than in accordance with the reasonable direction of an authorised person
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 14(2)(ii) and 23 of the Transport for London Railway Byelaws made under paragraph 26 of Schedule 11 to the Greater London Authority Act 1999 and confirmed under section 67 of the Transport Act 1962.

english.notes:
(i) See Byelaw 22 for the provision of a name and address by persons suspected of breaching this byelaw.
(ii) See byelaw 24 for a power to remove persons breaching this byelaw
(iii) See byelaw 25 for the requirement for authorised persons exercising any power conferred any of the Byelaws to produce a form of identification when requested to do so.
(iv) See byelaw 26 in relation to notices displayed.
(v) See byelaw 27 for the liability of authorised person acting in the course of his duties.
(vi) Byelaw 14(3) provides that no person in charge of any motor vehicle, bicycle or other conveyance shall park it on any part of the railway where charges are made for parking by the Operator or an authorised person without paying the appropriate charge at the appropriate time in accordance with instructions given by the Operator or an authorised person at that place.
(vii) Byelaw14(4) provides that the owner of any motor vehicle, bicycle or other conveyance used, left or placed in breach of any of Byelaws 14(1) to 14(3) may be liable to pay a penalty as displayed in that area.
(iii) Byelaw 14(5) provides that without prejudice to Byelaw 14(4), any motor vehicle, bicycle or other conveyance used, left or placed in breach of any of Byelaws 14(1) to 14(3) may be clamped, removed and/or stored by or under the direction of the Operator or an authorised person.
(viii) Byelaw 14(6) states that the owner of the motor vehicle, bicycle or other conveyance shall be liable to the Operator or authorised person for the costs incurred in clamping, removing and storing it provided that there is in that area a notice advising that any vehicle parked contrary to the Byelaws may be clamped, removed and stored by the Operator or authorised person and that the costs incurred by the Operator or authorised person for this may be recovered from the vehicle's owner.
(ix) Byelaw 14(7) provides that the power of clamping and removal referred to in Byelaw 14(5) shall not be exercisable in any area where passenger parking is permitted unless there is on display in that area a notice advising that any vehicle parked contrary to the Byelaws may be clamped and/or removed by the Operator or authorised person.
